parts.text: Turn the two lines of red headline text into a horror movie title made of glossy wet dark-red blood: the letters look thick and shiny, with realistic blood drips of uneven lengths running down from the bottom of every word, some long thin streaks and some fat drops, with wet highlights. Keep the exact same words, spelling, letters, font, size and positions: I KNOW WHAT YOU MINTED / LAST FRIDAY THE 13TH. Change nothing else in the image: keep the REVEAL FRIDAY line, the silhouettes, the bottom line and the black background exactly the same.
